tools.name: delete_alert_rule
tools.description: Deletes a custom alert rule permanently (write scope). System default rules cannot be deleted (403); they can be switched off with enabled: false.

tools.name: list_contacts
tools.description: Alert recipients (people) with their group memberships: who gets notified. Cursor-paginated.

tools.name: get_contact
tools.description: One contact by id: name, email address, phone number and the contact groups they are a member of.

tools.name: create_contact
tools.description: Creates an alert recipient (write scope), optionally placed straight into contact groups (group_ids). A duplicate email (case-insensitive) is refused as a conflict with the existing contact.

tools.name: update_contact
tools.description: Updates a contact (write scope); only the fields sent change. group_ids replaces all memberships ([] removes them from every group, omitted keeps them).

tools.name: delete_contact
tools.description: Deletes a contact permanently (write scope) and removes them from every contact group. Cannot be undone.

tools.name: list_contact_groups
tools.description: Contact groups (notification groups): where alerts are delivered, with the ids a monitor's config.notificationGroupIds and an alert rule's contact group refer to. Cursor-paginated.

tools.name: get_contact_group
tools.description: One contact group in detail, including its member list (who exactly gets paged).

tools.name: create_contact_group
tools.description: Creates a contact group (write scope), optionally with initial members (contact ids).

tools.name: update_contact_group
tools.description: Updates a contact group (write scope). contact_ids replaces the full member list ([] empties the group, omitted keeps it).

tools.name: delete_contact_group
tools.description: Deletes a contact group permanently (write scope). The organization's default group, and a group still used by monitors, alert rules or notification channels, are refused with 409 (with the counts) and nothing is deleted.

tools.name: get_status_page

tools.name: list_announcements

tools.name: get_on_call

tools.name: resolve_incident

tools.name: delete_maintenance_window
tools.description: Cancels a maintenance window permanently (write scope): it is removed with its future occurrences, and any active silences are lifted. Cannot be undone.
